animated-moment.name: Animated Moment
animated-moment.purpose: Render one controlled animated cue with label, state, and reduced-motion fallback without becoming onboarding, celebration, education system, or an animation-player runtime.

anatomy.rule: Owns the visible Animated Moment container.
Uses symbol, icon, or motion support.

animated-moment.statePrecedence: disabled > reduced-motion > paused > playing > complete > idle

props.notes: Lets the moment fill the owning region and use desktop composition when space allows.

do: Use Animated Moment for its bounded job.
dont: Do not treat the current package contract as a full animation-player runtime.
Onboarding, education, campaign, or multi-step animation sequences belong to patterns.
Do not create multi-step system inside it.
Do not rely on color or motion only.
info: Escalate to patterns when orchestration appears.

agentInstructions: Use Animated Moment only as a local animated cue.
Onboarding, education, campaign, or multi-step animation sequences belong to patterns.
Ask when orchestration or real external animation playback is required.
rejectIf: The component is described as a real animation-player runtime without package-owned player support.
Onboarding, education, campaign, or multi-step animation sequences belong to patterns.
